publicNote: Membership is now simple and honest: free Vault Member, VaultSparked at $4.99 a month and VaultSparked Eternal at $29.99 a month. Season 1 runs to October 14. New Vault accounts are invite-led for now; request an invite from the contact page.
nextMilestone: Keep browser collection independent of auth and preserve measured mobile evidence.
blockers: Obelisk production enrolment is still invite-only (re-probed 2026-10-02: 403), so the site routes visitors to an invite request. Ark question to Obelisk pending since S367.

Edge uptime sampler cannot run: Workers Free caps the account at 5 cron triggers and all five belong to other projects. Cloudflare error 10072. Needs a founder to free a slot or move to Workers Paid (billing, CANON-019).
604 pre-S349 uptime rows remain unresolvable — a challenge and a real edge outage are indistinguishable in them now the shape is gone. They are labelled, never re-scored, and age out naturally.
Identity/provider acceptance and scoped credential-owner reconciliation remain unresolved independently of this release.
Account signup acceptance, member newsletter arming, public-member-data and immutable warm-origin choices remain unobserved or undecided.
Field-vitals freshness requires a genuinely fresh RUM cohort; local lab evidence deliberately abstains.

The Supabase service-role slot in the secrets gateway points at the sibling project (supabase-credential-project-mismatch). Row-data admin is degraded; management, SQL and edge-function deploy authority are live and were used this session.
api/founder-presence.json still carries 30 revisions in public git history. The purge needs crons disabled, a filter-repo rewrite and a force-push — CANON-019 founder action.

lastSessionSummary: S380 complete: Playwright collects browser tests without loading Node unit suites and preserves mobile evidence. Collection is mandatory without authentication credentials; inventories are 689 Chromium, 619 Firefox and 619 WebKit tests. Fresh mobile cases passed 215/215 and survived collection byte-for-byte. The complete build passed 537/537 steps, isolation regressions 2/2, and Node tests 430 passed with zero failures and one existing TODO. Rank reports resolve privileged credentials only for their target and preserve previous evidence on fetch failure. Streamed SHA-256 verified the actual staging archive above 2 GiB; deployer self-tests passed 17/17. Shared brand, Discord and reaction names now contain their visible labels. Public accessibility passed 20/20; all 112 before/after captures across seven themes and two widths were inspected. Independent reviews passed, and concurrent Desk art commits were preserved by normal merge. Candidate 4ce367580b22 was pushed normally to main and fully deployed by confirmed Pages run 38763989597. Immutable and primary readback verified the deployed source. Staging verified 65/65 critical leaves and the tested source association. Browser checks passed three cases with three identity cases explicitly held; attention passed 15/15 and the production ceremony 11/11. All five publisher states were restored; canonical closeout is complete. Existing identity and field-vitals limitations remain separate. Broad optional E2E remains unresolved: 573 passed, 55 failed, 60 skipped, 1 flaky on exact candidate run 38761766861; the inherited workflow tolerates these failures when authentication email is absent.
